title: Return to Days of Winter
description: Viktor, a Fatuus stationed in Mondstadt, has finally received orders to return home...

mainQuestExcel.title: Return to Days of Winter
mainQuestExcel.description: Viktor, a Fatuus stationed in Mondstadt, has finally received orders to return home...

dialogs.text: Well, I guess I'm finally heading home...
Leaving us, Viktor?
Eh? Oh, it's you...
That's correct. I received orders from above recently that I can return to Snezhnaya.
Something about me being transferred to another Harbinger, and no longer needing to standby in Mondstadt for any new orders.
I've got no clue which of them I'll be under this time, but I'm just praying that it's not Lord Scaramouche...
When will you be leaving?
The higher-ups didn't mention that. I was just told to pack my things and be ready to leave at a moment's notice.
I mean, that's great, right? Finally, I'll be free from the judging gazes of those Sisters!
Ah, right, Traveler. Seeing as how we've had dealings for so long... Won't you do a man one last favor?
Like before, you'll do the deed, and I'll cough up the payment. You'll never work for free when you work with me.
What stories will you tell me this time?
Haha. To tell the truth, I'm all out of Fatui stories to tell you.
The payment this time will be Mora for sure. Sounds good?
Well, unless you'd like me to tell you the same fairy tales I tell Lily...
What do you need help with?
You know what? I'll come clean. The request this time also has something to do with her.
She's... well, the only person in all of Mondstadt who'll listen to anything "the evil Fatui uncle" says — other than you, of course.
I doubt I'll be returning to Mondstadt ever again... So I just wanted to send Lily one last memento.
But as you know, I'd be walking into a shooting gallery if I were to just walk out there and buy something.
So I can only leave this task to you.
Just head over to Marjorie's and help me see if she's got any gifts that a child might like.
You still keep Lily company?
Err... Well... Sometimes...
Aye, never a lack of Fatui stories with you around...
Did you get the present?
What will you do once you get back home?
What will I do? Well... I suppose I'll have to wait for my transfer orders.
*sigh* If things go ill, I might get transferred to some archon-forsaken place and put on standby again.
But I'm fine with whatever, so long as they don't toss me over to Inazuma...
Why the sudden move?
Why, you ask? It's because of Lady Signora's... Well... her sacrifice.
Actually, you know what? I'm just a joiner. I listen to orders. There's no need for me to think too much.
Where's Lily?
I heard Rudolf mention that he was going to take her out to the square or something like that.
Heh. I suppose he's got to keep his precious daughter away from the evil Fatui, eh?
See you.
Alright. I leave the matter of the present to you, then.
Lily, you shouldn't be talking to that Fatui.
But why not? Mister Fatooey's told me loadsa stowies!
Well, I guess I'm finally heading home...
Leaving us, Viktor?
Eh? Oh, it's you...
That's correct. I received orders from above recently that I can return to Snezhnaya.
Something about me being transferred to another Harbinger, and no longer needing to standby in Mondstadt for any new orders.
I've got no clue which of them I'll be under this time, though...

The higher-ups didn't mention that. I was just told to pack my things and be ready to leave at a moment's notice.

But as you know, I'd be walking into a shooting gallery if I were to just walk out there and buy something.

Just head over to Marjorie's and help me see if she's got any gifts that a child might like.

Err... Well... Sometimes...
Aye, never a lack of Fatui stories with you around...
Hello there, Traveler. What can I do for you?
Do you have any gifts for kids here?
A gift for a child... Let me think.
Hmm, actually, I've been attempting to fashion some small toys recently.
The only catch is that they need a lot of Wolfhook dye, and I'm all out of Wolfhooks.
I asked Schuster to help me gather some more, but he hasn't returned yet.
Could you help me look for Schuster, Traveler?
Once we have enough Wolfhooks, I should be able to make those toys for you.
Alright. Leave it to me.
He said that he'd be going <color=#00E1FFFF>near Wolvendom</color> to gather Wolfhooks. You can head over there to look for him.
In that case, I'm counting on you, Traveler.
Where has Schuster gone?
I'm counting on you, Traveler.
He said that he'd be going <color=#00E1FFFF>near Wolvendom</color> to gather Wolfhooks. You can head over there to look for him.
I'm counting on you, Traveler.
He said that he'd be going <color=#00E1FFFF>near Wolvendom</color> to gather Wolfhooks. You can head over there to look for him.
Th—Thank you, Traveler.
These monsters just kept coming after me, even after I ran all the way here...
You came to gather some Wolfhooks, right?
Eh? Yeah, it was Marjorie's request...
Couldn't you have brought someone else with you?
...Come on, who would've agreed to come with me to work on a commission as simple as "gathering plants"?
I know how that's supposed to work, of course, but you can only find Wolfhooks here, you know?
And the Wolfhooks that grow in safer areas have all been picked.
So I had to go further in to gather Wolfhooks...
But let's not talk about that now. Could you help me pass these Wolfhooks to Marjorie?
I need a moment to rest. I thought my legs were going to give out on me back there...
Please don't go out so far by yourself.
I'm counting on you, Traveler.
He said that he'd be going <color=#00E1FFFF>near Wolvendom</color> to gather Wolfhooks. You can head over there to look for him.
Did you manage to find Schuster, Traveler?
He asked me to take these Wolfhooks back to you.
Ah! Thank you very much. I'll take these, then.
Once Schuster gets back, I'll make sure he gets paid.
Right, you wanted a gift for a child, yes? Well then. Coming right up...
Marjorie starts to make the present...
Well, that's a wrap! Here, take this. Thanks for bringing those Wolfhooks back, by the way.
This doll has a light scent to it, too. I'm sure the kid you're sending this to will love it.
Could you help me deliver these Wolfhooks to Marjorie? I just need a moment to rest. I thought my legs were going to give out on me back there...
How did it go? Did you get the present?
I did.
Huh, I guess you're pretty good. Now let me see...
What is this...
This doll's all gangly and crooked, and its dye-job looks ridiculous... Well, it certainly smells nice, though.
Are you sure this is suitable for children?
This was Marjorie's recommendation.
This gift will have to do. But where do I put the letter... Eh, you know what, I'll just put it underneath...
You wrote Lily a letter?
Just some nonsense. Never you mind.
Alright. Here, take it, and help me deliver it to Lily. She should be <color=#00E1FFFF>near the square</color>.
Heh. I can picture the stares I'd be getting from Rudolf if I were to give it to her myself already...
What did you write to her?
You could always buy one in Snezhnaya and have it shipped here.
Oh, I'd love to. But just think about it. If a Fatuus were to send anything to Mondstadt, wouldn't it get stopped at the city gates by the Knights of Favonius?

flow.stepDescription: Deliver the present to Lily in turn

dialogs.text: Lily, you shouldn't be talking to that Fatui.
But why not? Mister Fatooey's told me loadsa stowies!
Hey there, Lily, Viktor got you a gift.
Wow! Mister Fatooey got me a pwesent? Thank you!
Wait, why would that Fatuus send Lily a present? Don't tell me that he...
That's becoz I gave Mister Fatooey lots of stuff to eat! That's why he sent me a gift!
Lily, he's not a good person...
But he tells me stowies! He's a good guy!
You can consider this Viktor's farewell gift.
Eh? Why does he have to go...
*sigh* He's leaving? Fine. I was beside myself with worry every day, what with that fellow talking to Lily every day and all.
Dadda, I wanna say bye bye to the Fatooey man!
*sigh* Lily, you shouldn't get too close to that man.
But why? That Fatooey... He's been really nice to me!
He tells me stowies. Lots of stowies! He's nice!
Lily, listen to Daddy. Things aren't that simple... *sigh* You know what? Daddy will tell you more when you're older.
Viktor's going to leave Mondstadt soon.
Help me deliver the present to Lily. She should be <color=#00E1FFFF>near the city square</color>.
If I were to go myself, I'm sure Rudolf would be glaring daggers at me all the way...
Did you send the present to Lily?
She's as pleased as punch.
That's good. I suppose Rudolf had his own two Mora's worth to say on the subject?
Hmph, you don't even have to say it. No one trusts a Fatuus here in Mondstadt.
When are you leaving?
The official order hasn't come down yet. I've just packed my things in advance, and I'll be staying at the Goth Grand Hotel for the time being — ready to leave at a moment's notice.
Come on, what's with that serious expression? Are you going to formally bid me farewell?
No.
Hah, that's right. That's how it should be. We're not friends. We're just ad-hoc partners.
If you should ever come to Snezhnaya, you can look for me there. We can continue doing business.
Alright, enough small talk. Here's your payment. Take it. I suppose this will be our last "equivalent exchange" here in Mondstadt.
*sigh* I just hope my next assignment isn't as troublesome...
But Dadda, he really is a good guy, and he tells great stowies!
Lily, things aren't that simple... *sigh* You know what? Daddy will tell you more when you're older.
*sigh* I just hope my next assignment isn't as troublesome...
